verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes show a live llms.txt at elevenlabs.io (HTTP 200). Documentation pages are also served as raw markdown (.md), and each one points agents to a complete page index at /docs/llms.txt, which is exactly what an AI-native user needs to point an agent at the docs. An official agents skill for AI coding assistants adds agent-oriented guidance on top of that. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt and markdown-docs conventions, and independent community corroboration of their usefulness.
